items.source: For streaming calls, the okhttp.requests span fires and is recorded in the registry, the timer is recorded in MeterRegistry, and traceparent is still propagated on the outbound request — but the span is not nested under the chat-model span. This is because the Anthropic SDK’s async streaming implementation hops onto ForkJoinPool.commonPool() before invoking Spring AI’s HTTP client, dropping the calling thread’s observation context at that boundary. Spring AI cannot recover the context from within its HTTP-client wrapper.
items.translation: 对于流式调用，okhttp.requests span 会触发并记录在注册表中，计时器记录在 MeterRegistry 中，且 traceparent 仍会传播到出站请求中——但该 span 并未嵌套在 chat-model span 下。 这是因为 Anthropic SDK 的异步流式实现会在调用 Spring AI 的 HTTP 客户端之前跳转到 ForkJoinPool.commonPool()，从而在那个边界处丢失了调用线程的观测上下文（observation context）。 Spring AI 无法在其 HTTP 客户端包装器内部恢复该上下文。

items.source: Nucleus sampling parameter. The model considers tokens with top_p probability mass. Supported on Claude Opus 4.6 and earlier models only. Deprecated by Anthropic for models released after Claude Opus 4.6 (e.g. claude-opus-4-7); values < 0.99 are rejected with HTTP 400, and values >= 0.99 are accepted as a backward-compatibility no-op (no actual filtering applied).
items.translation: 核采样参数。模型会考虑 top_p 概率质量内的 token。仅支持 Claude Opus 4.6 及更早的模型。Anthropic 已弃用在 Claude Opus 4.6 之后发布的模型（例如 claude-opus-4-7）中的此功能；小于 < 0.99 的值将返回 HTTP 400 错误，而大于或等于 >= 0.99 的值将被视为向后兼容的无操作（不执行实际过滤）。

items.source: Spring AI can additionally bind OkHttp connection-pool gauges (okhttp.pool.connection.count with state=active|idle and client.kind=sync|async) to the application’s MeterRegistry. These are secondary telemetry — useful for capacity tuning but not required for tracing or per-request latency — so they’re disabled by default.
items.translation: Spring AI 还可以将 OkHttp 连接池指标（带有 state=active|idle 和 client.kind=sync|async 的 okhttp.pool.connection.count）绑定到应用程序的 MeterRegistry。 这些是次要遥测数据——对于容量调优很有用，但对于链路追踪或单次请求延迟并非必需——因此它们默认处于禁用状态。

items.source: The Anthropic API includes rate limit headers on every response that report your current request and token budgets along with when each window resets. Spring AI exposes this data through the standard ChatResponseMetadata#getRateLimit() accessor, which returns an AnthropicRateLimit populated from the response headers.
items.translation: Anthropic API 在每个响应中都包含 速率限制标头 (rate limit headers)，用于报告您当前的请求和 Token 配额，以及每个窗口的重置时间。 Spring AI 通过标准的 ChatResponseMetadata#getRateLimit() 访问器暴露这些数据，该方法返回一个从响应标头中填充的 AnthropicRateLimit 对象。

items.source: When a turn triggers tool calls, each round appends an assistant tool_use message and a user tool_result message, and the growing history is sent back to Anthropic on every round. By default the CONVERSATION_HISTORY breakpoint lands on the last user message, so tool results — which are appended after it — fall outside every breakpoint and are billed as uncached input on each round. This is wasteful when tool outputs are large.
items.translation: 当一轮对话触发工具调用时，每一轮都会追加一条助手 tool_use 消息和一条用户 tool_result 消息，并且不断增长的历史记录在每一轮中都会发送回 Anthropic。默认情况下，CONVERSATION_HISTORY 断点落在最后一条用户消息上，因此在它之后追加的工具结果会落在每个断点之外，并在每一轮中作为未缓存输入计费。当工具输出内容较大时，这种做法非常浪费。

items.source: The breakpoint moves to the latest tool result on each round, so the previous rounds' tool outputs are read from cache while the newest is written. This consumes one additional cache breakpoint (Anthropic allows up to four per request), leaving room for the tool, system, and last-user breakpoints under CONVERSATION_HISTORY. The TTL and minimum content length are configurable via messageTypeTtl(MessageType.TOOL, …​) and messageTypeMinContentLength(MessageType.TOOL, …​).
items.translation: 断点在每一轮中都会移动到最新的工具结果上，因此之前的轮次的工具输出将从缓存中读取，而最新的输出将被写入。这会消耗一个额外的缓存断点（Anthropic 每个请求允许最多四个），从而为 CONVERSATION_HISTORY 下的工具、系统和最后用户断点留出空间。TTL 和最小内容长度可以通过 messageTypeTtl(MessageType.TOOL, …​) 和 messageTypeMinContentLength(MessageType.TOOL, …​) 进行配置。

items.source: AnthropicChatOptions implements the StructuredOutputChatOptions interface, which provides portable getOutputSchema() method. This allows structured output to work with Spring AI’s generic structured output infrastructure.
items.translation: AnthropicChatOptions 实现了 StructuredOutputChatOptions 接口，该接口提供可移植的 getOutputSchema() 方法。这使得结构化输出能够与 Spring AI 的通用结构化输出基础设施协同工作。

items.source: Anthropic offers different service tiers that control capacity routing for API requests. You can use AnthropicServiceTier.AUTO to opportunistically use priority capacity (lower latency) when available, or STANDARD_ONLY to always use standard capacity.
items.translation: Anthropic 提供不同的 服务层级，用于控制 API 请求的容量路由。您可以使用 AnthropicServiceTier.AUTO 在可用时机会性地使用优先容量（更低延迟），或使用 STANDARD_ONLY 始终使用标准容量。

items.source: HTTP layer. An okhttp.requests observation wraps every HTTP attempt to the Anthropic API, carrying HTTP method, URI, status code, and exception tags. Each request also propagates traceparent on the wire to any downstream services (AI gateways, OpenAI-compatible inference servers, proxies).
items.translation: HTTP 层。 一个 okhttp.requests 观测项会包裹每一次对 Anthropic API 的 HTTP 请求，携带 HTTP 方法、URI、状态码和异常标签。每个请求还会将 traceparent 在线传播到任何下游服务（AI 网关、兼容 OpenAI 的推理服务器、代理）。

items.source: If you need to correlate streaming HTTP spans with their parent chat-model span in your tracing UI, filter by span name okhttp.requests with host api.anthropic.com and join to the corresponding gen_ai.client.operation span by trace ID or timestamp range. Built-in parent linkage for streaming is being pursued upstream in the Anthropic Java SDK.
items.translation: 如果您需要在追踪 UI 中将流式 HTTP spans 与其父级 chat-model span 相关联，请按 span 名称 okhttp.requests 且 host 为 api.anthropic.com 进行过滤，并根据 trace ID 或时间戳范围与相应的 gen_ai.client.operation span 进行关联。 流式传输的内置父级链接功能正在 Anthropic Java SDK 的上游进行开发中。

items.source: You can register custom Java functions or methods with the AnthropicChatModel and have Claude intelligently choose to output a JSON object containing arguments to call one or many of the registered functions/tools. items.source: SUMMARIZED — Claude still thinks fully, but returns a condensed summary instead of the raw chain-of-thought. Reduces output tokens while still providing insight into the reasoning.

items.source: Anthropic’s Citations API allows Claude to reference specific parts of provided documents when generating responses. When citation documents are included in a prompt, Claude can cite the source material, and citation metadata (character ranges, page numbers, or content blocks) is returned in the response metadata.
items.translation: Anthropic 的 Citations API 允许 Claude 在生成回答时引用所提供文档的特定部分。 当提示词中包含引用文档时，Claude 可以引用源材料，并且引用元数据（字符范围、页码或内容块）将包含在响应元数据中。

items.source: Transparency: See exactly which parts of documents informed the response
items.translation: 透明度：准确查看哪些文档部分构成了此次回答的依据

items.translation: 检查空引用：并非所有响应都包含引用，因此在访问之前，请务必验证引用元数据是否存在。

items.source: Consider document size: Larger documents provide more context but consume more input tokens and may affect response time.
items.translation: 考虑文档大小：较大的文档能提供更多上下文，但会消耗更多的输入 token 并可能影响响应时间。

items.translation: 利用多个文档：在回答跨越多个来源的问题时，请在单次请求中提供所有相关文档，而不是进行多次调用。

items.source: Use appropriate document types: Choose plain text for simple content, PDF for existing documents, and custom content blocks when you need fine-grained control over citation granularity.
items.translation: 使用适当的文档类型：对于简单内容选择纯文本，对于现有文档选择 PDF，而在需要对引用粒度进行精细控制时，请选择自定义内容块。

items.source: Anthropic’s Skills API extends Claude’s capabilities with specialized, pre-packaged abilities for document generation. Skills enable Claude to create actual downloadable files — Excel spreadsheets, PowerPoint presentations, Word documents, and PDFs — rather than just describing what these documents might contain.
items.translation: Anthropic 的 Skills API 通过专门的预包装能力扩展了 Claude 在文档生成方面的功能。 Skills 使 Claude 能够创建实际可供下载的文件——包括 Excel 表格、PowerPoint 演示文稿、Word 文档和 PDF 文件——而不仅仅是描述这些文档可能包含的内容。

items.source: Use appropriate models: Skills work best with Claude Sonnet 4 and later models. Ensure you’re using a supported model.
items.translation: 使用合适的模型：技能在 Claude Sonnet 4 及更高版本模型上效果最佳。请确保您正在使用受支持的模型。

items.source: Be specific in prompts: Provide clear, detailed instructions about document structure, content, and formatting.
items.translation: 提示词要具体：提供关于文档结构、内容和格式的清晰、详细的指令。

items.source: Handle file downloads promptly: Generated files expire after 24 hours. Download files soon after generation.
items.translation: 及时处理文件下载：生成的文件将在 24 小时后过期。请在生成后尽快下载文件。

items.source: Check for file IDs: Always verify that file IDs were returned before attempting downloads. Some prompts may result in text responses without file generation.
items.translation: 检查文件 ID：在尝试下载之前，务必验证是否返回了文件 ID。某些提示可能会导致仅生成文本响应而没有生成文件。

items.source: Use defensive error handling: Wrap file operations in try-catch blocks to handle network issues or expired files gracefully.
items.translation: 使用防御性错误处理：将文件操作封装在 try-catch 块中，以优雅地处理网络问题或过期文件。

items.source: By default Spring AI manages the OkHttp dispatcher’s executor — an unbounded pool of platform threads, replicating the SDK’s stock behavior. For workloads with high HTTP concurrency, or to take advantage of Java 21+ virtual threads, you can supply your own ExecutorService:
items.translation: 默认情况下，Spring AI 管理 OkHttp 的 dispatcher 执行器——这是一个平台线程的无界池，复制了 SDK 的默认行为。 对于具有高 HTTP 并发量的负载，或者为了利用 Java 21+ 的虚拟线程，您可以提供自定义的 ExecutorService：

items.source: The same executor backs both the sync and async (streaming) clients. When you supply your own executor, you own its lifecycle — Spring AI will never call shutdown() on it. When omitted, the internal executor is created and cleaned up automatically.
items.translation: 相同的 executor 同时支持同步和异步（流式）客户端。 当您提供自己的 executor 时，您负责其生命周期——Spring AI 永远不会对其调用 shutdown()。 如果省略该参数，系统将自动创建并清理内部 executor。
